card.name: Words just before an N-starting piece
card.fires_on: Responds to a word or word part right before a piece beginning with N, such as 'United' before Nations, or CARD-IO or CENT-RAL in all-caps warnings. It is strongest on 'United' in 'United Nations'.

modes.label: United before Nations
modes.description: The word 'United' in references to the United Nations.
modes.example: Department of Economic and Social Affairs,<< United>> Nations Secretariat.

modes.label: Split capitalized warning words
modes.description: Partway through long all-caps boxed-warning words, just before an N-starting piece or word.
modes.example: PERIPHERAL NEUROPATHY, CENT<<RAL>> NERVOUS SYSTEM EFFECTS AND

card.writes: It boosts N-starting pieces like 'nest' and 'n', and suppresses AN/UN/EN/IN pieces.
card.plain: It fires on a word that is about to be followed by something starting with N, like United Nations or central nervous system.
